**These builds are unsigned betas.** Nothing is wrong with the download: code-signing certificates
cost money and this project does not have them yet, so your OS will warn you the first time.

**Windows:** download `Cubby-Setup-x.y.z.exe` and run it. If SmartScreen says "Windows protected your
PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. It installs per user and needs no administrator rights.

**macOS (experimental, untested):** download `Cubby-x.y.z-universal.dmg` and drag Cubby to
Applications. The first time, right-click Cubby, choose **Open**, then **Open** again. On macOS 15 and
later, open it once, then go to System Settings, Privacy and Security, and click **Open Anyway**.

Full instructions, including the macOS permissions Cubby asks for, are in the README.
